newsitem.title: USA: CIGNA up after Q1 beats forecasts.
newsitem.headline: CIGNA up after Q1 beats forecasts.

text.p: Shares of CIGNA Corp rose sharply after the company posted better-than-expected first quarter profits.
CIGNA reported first quarter operating profits of $3.49 a share after the stock market close on Wednesday. The First Call consensus was $3.11 a share.
CIGNA shares rose 3-3/4, or more than two percent, to 154-2/8 in mid-morning trading.

Sanford C. Bernstein analyst Weston Hicks said CIGNA's HMO results appeared to be turning the corner. He said the company realized 3.5 percent price increases in the first quarter and said price momentum appears to be building.
In addition, he said, the medical cost trend was flat.
CIGNA also turned in strong results outside the United States, with the international accident and health business posting growth of 18 percent.
